name: Overloading Arch (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) or DC 18 Arcana check, DC 18 Nature check, DC 18 Occultism check, or DC 18 Religion check (trained) to seal each of the four time rifts, DC 20 Crafting check (trained) to divert the lightning to another source, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 17) to counteract each time rift. Each attempt requires 2 actions. Skill checks to disable a time rift must attempted from adjacent to the rift.
routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled time rift. On each of the trap's actions, the Eternity Arch releases a bolt of lightning that activates that rift, dealing 2d6 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the time rift (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). It can release a bolt at each active time rift no more than once each turn.

items.name: Shock
items.text:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of one of the time rifts

---

Effect The triggering creature takes 1d6 electricity damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). The overloading arch rolls initiative.

text: The Eternity Arch sparks with electricity, releasing bolts of lightning at each of the four largest time rifts.
